args.summary: After the latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) to production, the service started failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. SRE rolled back checkout-api in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions with an ~18% error rate. The deployment history showed the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Health is now restored — status is **healthy** with an error rate of ~0.2%.
3. **Open incident**: Opened a SEV2 incident for checkout-api documenting the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.

The service is healthy again, and the on-call team is notified for follow-up on v2.3.1.
